journal_lines: §aOld shaft, fresh ore behind the rot. §oThe smell of iron was stronger than the smell of age. Followed it.
§aSomeone else's tunnel — old supports, old rails. §oThe ore they left behind was not old at all.
§aAbandoned mineshaft. Tools still present, ore still present. One of those things is more useful than the other.
§aCart on the tracks, still loaded, wood gone soft. §oTipped it into my bag. The ore had been patient.
§aThey stopped just short of the good seam. §oOld shaft, wrong exit. Did not make the same mistake.
§aFound a lantern on a hook, long empty. Lit my own and went further. §oThe ore was further.
§aFollowed the rails until they ran out, then followed the dust they had left in the rock. Worth it.
§aCobwebs over the entrance thick as cloth. §oBrushed through. The shaft behind them still had work in it.
